verdict.rationale: Docusign publishes official client SDKs (e.g., the docusign-esign-node-client on GitHub) built from maintained OpenAPI/Swagger specs, backed by a dedicated Developer Center with REST API docs, and community reports confirm smooth API integrations in practice (docusign-docs-13, docusign-docs-21, docusign-docs-22, docusign-gh-1, docusign-gh-2, docusign-comm-5). Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable spec at the expected endpoints (openapi.json/llms.txt both 404), and more consistent independent corroboration since some community reports describe painful integrations.
